metadata.description: CEH Claude Code plugins for the full software development lifecycle.

plugins.name: ceh-coding-agent
plugins.description: CEH coding-agent standards: the behavior contract and five-step workflow, write-less-code minimalism, retroactive refactoring, whole-repo explanation, and context economy via delegated bulk reads.

plugins.name: ceh-git-workflow
plugins.description: CEH Git workflow: commits, branching, PRs (with definition-of-done gate), merging, changelog entries, releases, code review, and dependency management. Includes two orchestrated flows — merge-flow lands a branch, release-flow ships a release.
